title: Mirror Paddle Chant
style: Phonk rap with a lurching half-time bounce and dusty percussion, built on chopped vocal chants, hard sub pulses, and call-and-response hooks; verse rides sparse drums and a warped bass murmur, pre-chorus tightens with reversed swells and handclap snaps, chorus hits with gang vocal shouts and a pitched lead hook. Close-mic gritty vocal, wide ad-libs, glossy low-end, sneaky tape-warp ear candy.
